content: To see the truth of the mountain, you must not fear the mist along the trail.
author: Japanese Proverbs
explanation: Clarity is rarely given at the trailhead. The mountain ascent is cloaked in dense fog where you can only see two steps ahead. Courage is not knowing the whole journey; it is placing your foot down firmly into the mist.
practicalInsight: Take the next necessary step on your project even if you cannot yet see how the entire year will unfold.
reflectionPrompt: What decision are you putting off while waiting for '100% certainty' that will never arrive?
